title: Remittance Reading Guide: The Waivable Cost Share of a Named Posting
content:
On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, the part of a named posting that a hardship waiver may waive depends on what the posting is and on the tier's cost-share design.

**Guide.** The waivable cost share is, for a remittance posting on a tier where the plan deductible applies and the posting carries a deductible part, the coinsurance part in full plus 0.5 of the deductible part, the coinsurance part being the tier's coinsurance percent of the allowed amount less the deductible part and the deductible part being the posting's amount less the coinsurance percent of the allowed amount, divided by one less the coinsurance percent; for a remittance posting on a tier with a copay per 30-day supply above 0, the lower of the posting's amount and that copay; and otherwise the posting's amount.

- A *remittance posting* is a posting of remittance patient responsibility; a patient charge or a refund is not one.
- The posting *carries a deductible part* when that deductible part comes to more than 0.

| Tier | Deductible applies | Coinsurance | Copay per 30-day supply | Waivable cost share of a remittance posting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | No | 0 percent | 35.00 | lower of the posting and 35.00 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | Yes | 20 percent | 0.00 | coinsurance part plus half the deductible part, when a deductible part exists |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | No | 20 percent | 0.00 | the posting's amount |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | Yes | 20 percent | 0.00 | coinsurance part plus half the deductible part, when a deductible part exists |

**Worked readings (hypothetical remittances)**

- 20 percent coinsurance, allowed amount 100.00, posting 44.00: the deductible part is 44.00 less 20.00, divided by 0.8, that is 30.00; the coinsurance part is 20 percent of 70.00, that is 14.00; the waivable cost share is 14.00 plus half of 30.00, that is 29.00.
- The same tier, allowed amount 100.00, posting 20.00: the deductible part is 0, so the waivable cost share is the posting's 20.00.
- Copay tier, remittance posting 50.00: the lower of 50.00 and 35.00, that is 35.00; a remittance posting of 20.00 stays 20.00.
- A patient charge named on the application: its amount, on any tier.
